summary: _Order in Petition No. 435/GT/2020 Page 3 of 31_ 4. The Petitioner, on 12.5.2021, filed additional affidavit to place on record certain additional information, with copy to Respondents. The Respondent, MSEDCL has filed its reply affidavit on 4.6.2021. The Respondent CSPDCL and Respondent MPPMCL have also filed their separate reply affidavits on 23.7.2021. The Petitioner has filed its rejoinder affidavits to the replies of the above respondents on 30.7.2021. The Petitioner has also filed certain additional information on 4.6.2021. The Commission, after hearing the parties, on 30.11.2021, through video conferencing, reserved its order in the matter. The Petitioner has also filed its note of arguments on 1.12.2021. It has also filed certain additional information vide affidavits on 115.12.2021. Based on the submissions of the parties and the documents available on record and on prudence check, we proceed to examine the claims of the Petitioner, in this Petition, for the 2019-24 tariff period, as stated in the subsequent paragraphs. _Order in Petition No. 435/GT/2020 Page 4 of 31_ - _(a) Liabilities to meet award of arbitration or for compliance of the directions or order of any statutory authority, or order or decree of any court of law;_ _Order in Petition No. 435/GT/2020 Page 5 of 31_ _(a) Liabilities to meet award of arbitration or for compliance of order or directions of any statutory authority, or order or decree of any court of law;_ _Order in Petition No. 435/GT/2020 Page 6 of 31_ _Order in Petition No. 435/GT/2020 Page 7 of 31_ _Order in Petition No. 435/GT/2020 Page 8 of 31_ _Order in Petition No. 435/GT/2020 Page 9 of 31_ _Order in Petition No. 435/GT/2020 Page 11 of 31_ has been considered for the purpose of tariff. The Petitioner has raised similar issues with regard to fly ash transportation in that petition arguing higher liability of the Respondents therein on account of interest burden and cash flow issues that may be faced by the Petitioner and the Respondents have raised the issue of ‘maintainability’ of the said petition. However, the Commission vide its order dated 28.5.2022 has ‘admitted’ the petition and directed the parties to complete their pleadings in the matter, on merits. The reimbursement of charges towards fly ash transportation shall, therefore, be governed by the final decision of the Commission in Petition No. 205/MP/2021. _Order in Petition No. 435/GT/2020 Page 22 of 31_ _Order in Petition No. 435/GT/2020 Page 23 of 31_ _Order in Petition No. 435/GT/2020 Page 27 of 31_ _Order in Petition No. 435/GT/2020 Page 28 of 31_ _Order in Petition No. 435/GT/2020 Page 29 of 31_ 65.
